# apple_expire_build (Action)

Expires a build, so testers can no longer install it. Expiring cannot be undone.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Run with: terraform apply -invoke=action.apple_expire_build.old
action "apple_expire_build" "old" {
  config {
    build_id = "8a7b6c5d-4e3f-4a2b-9c1d-0e9f8a7b6c5d"
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `build_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the build, e.g. `data.apple_build.latest.id`.
